plan.notes: Official 'Suggested Course Sequence' from Cabrillo College (Economics AA-T  - Transfer Pathway to CSUMB). Cabrillo labels this 'a suggested sequence of coursework' and notes 'This is not an official educational plan'; sequenced here as the college's published pathway. Credit ranges use the source lower bound: MATH 18 / MATH 5A: 4-5, lower bound used; CAL-GETC AREA 4 SOCIAL AND BEHAVIORAL SCIENCES: 3-4, lower bound used; BUS 9, PSYCH 2A, / STAT C1000: 3-5, lower bound used; ANY ECONOMICS AA-T LIST A COURSE: 3-5, lower bound used; MATH 5C, MATH 6, / any Economics AA-T List A course not already used: 3-5, lower bound used; CAL-GETC AREA 5B BIOLOGICAL SCIENCE: 3-5, lower bound used; CAL-GETC AREA 3B HUMANITIES: 3-5, lower bound used; CAL-GETC AREA 5A PHYSICAL SCIENCE: 3-5, lower bound used.
